content.title: Zendaya and Tom Holland: Have the Spider-Man stars secretly got married?
content.text: Image source, Getty ImagesImage caption, Tom Holland and Zendaya met as they were making Spider-ManSpidey-senses are tingling all over the world, as people wonder: Have a Hollywood super-couple had a secret wedding?Tom Holland and Zendaya are very private people - they got engaged in late 2024 and kept it a secret for a couple of months.It had already been hinted that they both wanted to plan a wedding away from the cameras, but a few things have happened which are leading some people to believe it has already taken place.Here's what's going on and why it's got fans talking.A red her-ring?Image source, Getty ImagesImage caption, Zendaya showed her engagement ring off in early 2025Tom and Zendeya's engagement wasn't really announced and instead she was spotted wearing an engagement ring at the 2025 Golden Globes.Then in February 2026, Zendaya was spotted in Los Angeles appearing to have swapped her big diamond engagement ring for what looked like a plain gold band on her left hand.That got people talking because that's a more traditional style for a wedding ring.Since then, both her stylist and her mum have made comments adding fuel to the rumours that their wedding has already taken place.'You missed it!'Image source, Getty ImagesImage caption, Zendaya's stylist has seemingly broken the news that Zendaya and Tom are already marriedTwo weeks after Zendaya was spotted wearing what looked like a wedding ring, her stylist Law Roach was interviewed at a red carpet event at the Actor Awards ceremony.When he was asked if he was busy planning looks for Zendaya's wedding, he responded: "The wedding has already happened... you missed it."Image source, Getty ImagesImage caption, They're one of the most famous couples in the worldAnd to add more mystery, Zendaya's mum Claire Stoermer shared the video of Law's interview on her socials, not saying it was untrue, but with just a laughing face emoji.What could it all mean?!Keeping up their plan to keep their private lives private, the two stars haven't commented on the situation themselves at all.How did Tom Holland and Zendaya meet?Media caption, Tom Holland and Zendaya met Ricky before the premiere of No Way HomeThe pair met on the set of Spider-Man: Homecoming in 2016 when Tom played the Marvel hero and she starred as MJ.Their real-life romance was confirmed in 2021.When's the next Spiderman film coming out?Media caption, Filming has been underway for some time - here you can see Tom Holland doing some scenes in GlasgowThe potential newlyweds will be on the big screen again later this year, for the next instalment of the Spider-Man franchise.Spider-Man: Brand New Day will see Peter Parker (Tom Holland) setting off to college, and trying to leave the spider life behind.If you remember, at the end of the last film, everyone had forgotten the connection between Peter and his webslinger identity, and MJ had forgotten Peter altogether!However, when he finds out his friends are in danger, he'll suit up once more to save them, and the world.
